raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver mixes the two. Late-evening local v2 transactions land on the next UTC date at 00:00-06:00 (all 41 rows on 01-19 and 37 rows on 01-18). Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time puts them on the correct business date and in opening hours.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH n AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM n;"}}
